static_traits.name: Li Ming杰
static_traits.family_status: Lives with parents and a younger sibling
static_traits.social_status: 家庭支持存在，但与朋友和家人Relationship tension，情绪trigger时倾向自我隔离
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness，not yet曾接受过心理治疗
static_traits.language_features: 表达犹豫，常用negate性自评与模糊表述（如“我not知道”“很难描述”）；能配合但持怀疑态度；易淡化正面反馈

basic_info.main_problem: 我长期有“not够好”或“not配成功”的感觉，近几个月加重；在取得成就或被表扬时会怀疑自己的成就，觉得自己not值得任何认可；压力与自我期待使问题发展到对成就产生怀疑。
basic_info.core_demands: 这些not够好的感受正在影响我的动力、自尊和整体心理健康，我需要帮助来处理并克服这些负面想法。
growth_experiences: 自幼至今持续存在“I am not good enough/not配成功”的内在体验，近几个月在Academic pressure与自我期望增高的情境下明显加重；在取得成就或被他人赞扬时尤其容易triggerSelf-doubt与negate。
在以往的Academic pressure期，曾通过“更努力、设定更高目标”的方式进行应对；虽然能一时推动表现，但也Reinforcement了以苛刻标准评价自我、not yet达即negate的认知与行为模式。

special_situations.event: When making concrete progress (such as continuously saving for the dream Porsche and making obvious progress)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果这件事“谁都能做到”，就not算真正的成就
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 通过贬低或negate自己的成果来维持对自我价值的谨慎评估

special_situations.event: 当收到他人的赞美或正向反馈时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 若我并not完美或付出not够，任何赞美都not算数
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 淡化他人的肯定、强调自己的not足以避免被看穿
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们只是客气，并not了解我其实not付出多少

special_situations.event: When comparing grades or achievements with peers or others
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有比do not人更好才值得认可；not是最优秀就等于失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断提高目标、加压自己并频繁与他人比较
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我的成就have not意义，do not人都更强

special_situations.event: 在not yet达到自我设定的高标准或遭遇Academic pressure时期
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 达not到高期望就证明I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 拼命努力、设定更高目标来弥补not够好

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be genuinely seen and recognized, feeling oneself worthy of success and praise
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被negate或被揭穿为“not配/骗子”，害怕暴露not够好后被羞辱
defense_goal: 通过negate或淡化成就来降低被揭穿的风险
Keeping distance from others to avoid being evaluated or burdening family
Demands more of himself with higher standards to gain a sense of control and safety

object_relations.self_representation: not够好、配not上成功的“被怀疑者/骗子”
object_relations.object_representation: 外界是苛刻的评判者或表面友好但not真正理解自己的人

object_relations.self_representation: 会给亲人带来负担的Withdrawal者
object_relations.object_representation: Family are people I would drag down, from whom I need to hide problems

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others invite reviewing achievements and give positive affirmation
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为对方只是客气或not了解真实付出（移情：把他人体验为not理解的评判者）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以平淡、克制的语气强调“这not算什么”，突出自己的not足与付出not多，用解释淡化他人的肯定。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked to try new self-affirmation exercises or face the possibility of positive change
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将改变视为几乎not可能，担心被证明自己not配（移情：把咨询师的鼓励体验为施压）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use犹豫和怀疑的语气，频繁表示“not确定有用”，通过拖延与降低期待来回避练习的情感影响。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 在谈及与他人比较或Academic pressure的话题时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 把他人视为更优秀的威胁者，确信自己必然not如人（移情：Projection）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Quickly asserts 'they are all better' with declarative sentences, reducing self-exploration, avoiding discussion of own efforts and strengths.

manifestations: 在取得成就或受到赞美时仍认为“have not意义/not算数”
After frequent comparisons with others, feels a lack of self-worth
outcomes: 对曾经感兴趣的活动失去兴趣

manifestations: Avoids communicating with family and friends to avoid 'adding burden to the family'
在情绪trigger时选择自我隔离
outcomes: 主观压力感增强、without助感增加

contact_model.definition: 个体存在not良的自我Reflection与过度自我限制、自我苛责，对接触过于小心谨慎。
manifestations: Excessively compares with others and demands higher standards of oneself
难以接纳赞美与正向反馈

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: 将他人的赞美理解为“只是客气”或“not理解我”
推断他人的动机为虚假或not准确

contact_model.definition: The individual turns the energy of the original desire directed outward toward himself, or gives up seeking others to do something for him outwardly.
manifestations: not向家人倾诉以“not要麻烦do not人”为由
在情绪trigger时选择独自承受而非寻求支持

exception_events.target_problem: 在取得进展或获得赞美时，来访者通常会贬低自己的成就、产生“我not配/not够好”的想法，随后Decreased drive并与他人疏离。
exception_events.unique_outcome: In the past few months, has persistently made and carried out a savings plan for the Porsche of his dreams, depositing according to the plan and making clear progress; in this process he maintained engagement and self-management.
exception_events.reason: 线索：设定了明确且可量化的目标与计划；任务具有阶段性成果可见；家庭环境稳定、节奏可控，使其能维持行动并看到正反馈，因此这次表现not同。

positive_force: Able to set goals and advance through sustained action (savings plan making progress)
Family support exists; has support resources available to use
具备一定自我觉察，能识do not“贬低正面”的思维模式
negative_force: Excessive self-comparison, often judges oneself by others' standards
高标准与完美化倾向，not yet达即Self-denial
难以接纳赞美，倾向negate正向反馈
因羞耻与Self-doubt而回避亲友，导致Relationship tension与Loneliness
睡眠not规律与兴趣降低，进一步削弱学习动力

target_behavior.behavior: negate与贬低自身成就的自动化思维与言语
antecedent: Has made phased progress toward goals (such as results in saving money)
target_behavior.core_reason: 核心信念“I am not good enough/not配成功”，并担心被揭穿为“骗子”
target_behavior.function: 逃避被评判与暴露not完美，维持Self-protection的低期待
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased drive、Impaired self-esteem、Low mood，进一步影响学业与人际

antecedent: not yet达到自我设定的高标准
target_behavior.core_reason: 将not yet达目标视为“彻底失败”，引发逃避与耗竭
target_behavior.function: 短期逃避要求与失败感，缓解即时Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 成绩下降、学习效率降低

target_behavior.core_reason: 羞耻与Self-doubt，担心被他人看见真实的not足
target_behavior.function: Avoids being evaluated and emotional exposure, maintaining surface safety

antecedent: 持续Academic pressure与负性自我评价活跃
target_behavior.core_reason: Low mood与认知负荷导致作息失衡与快感缺失
target_behavior.function: Short-term avoidance of stress and tasks (such as procrastination, staying up late)
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased energy, more lateness to class, further reduced study efficiency
